```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "Dockerfile"
      - ".github/workflows/docker-smoke.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "Dockerfile"
      - ".github/workflows/docker-smoke.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  DOCKERHUB_IMAGE: khak1s/arr-dashboard
  GHCR_IMAGE: ghcr.io/kha-kis/arr-dashboard

jobs:
  smoke-test:
    name: Docker Smoke Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and tag image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: false
          load: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:smoke-test
            ${{ env.GHCR_IMAGE }}:smoke-test
          build-args: |
            VERSION=smoke-test
            COMMIT_SHA=${{ github.sha }}
            BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_commit.timestamp || github.event.repository.updated_at }}

      - name: Run container and test basic functionality
        run: |
          # Start container
          CONTAINER_ID=$(docker run -d \
            --name smoke-test-container \
            -p 3000:3000 \
            ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:smoke-test)
          
          # Wait for container to be ready
          sleep 10
          
          # Test health endpoint
          HEALTH_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/health)
          
          # Test basic page load
          PAGE_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/)
          
          # Stop container
          docker stop $CONTAINER_ID
          docker rm $CONTAINER_ID
          
          # Validate results
          if [ "$HEALTH_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Health check failed with status: $HEALTH_STATUS"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ "$PAGE_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Page load failed with status: $PAGE_STATUS"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All smoke tests passed!"

      - name: Run container with environment variables
        run: |
          # Start container with minimal env vars
          CONTAINER_ID=$(docker run -d \
            --name smoke-test-env \
            -p 3001:3000 \
            -e NODE_ENV=production \
            -e DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///tmp/test.db \
            ${{ env.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE }}:smoke-test)
          
          # Wait for container to be ready
          sleep 10
          
          # Test health endpoint
          HEALTH_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3001/health)
          
          # Stop container
          docker stop $CONTAINER_ID
          docker rm $CONTAINER_ID
          
          # Validate result
          if [ "$HEALTH_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Environment variable test failed with status: $HEALTH_STATUS"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Environment variable tests passed!"
```
